ops.title: Cleanup busy gate must follow the admitted deletion root
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali. Next step: replace deletesAt guesses with the same location resolution used by admission and check the returned DeletionRoot before opening or stepping. Evidence at 60eefaf1b: activity.go:112-120 returns Original for adopted/moved trees and Payload for deleting_admin; relocate/inplace.go:27-45,627-677,744-777 and relocate/displaced.go:289-371 can hand back Source, Registered, Payload, a retired registration, or an external admin instead. A busy job can Advance or delete under a quiet root. Review was source-only; no tests ran.

ops.text: Every supported phase uses its actual next deletion location for busy admission, including adopted and relocated trees and both admin paths.
A held unstrained activity gate allows free jobs and stops Advance and physical deletion at protected locations; downstream validation verifies phase and root transitions.
